item.title: The Weeknd’s 2026 Shows Add $440 Million and 3 Million Tickets to Record-Breaking World Tour – So Far
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome back to the show, music lovers. Today, we're talking about one of the biggest tours in history - The Weeknd's After Hours Til Dawn Tour. This global trek has been making waves for years, and 2026 is shaping up to be its biggest year yet."
[Music transition]
Host: "According to Billboard, the tour is expected to generate $440 million in ticket sales, with over 3 million fans in attendance. Last year, The Weeknd broke R&B records, becoming the highest-grossing and best-selling tour in the genre's history. And with this year's shows in Latin America, Europe, and Asia, it's transcending genres to become the highest-grossing tour by a solo male artist."
[Music transition]
Host: "The numbers are staggering. Since launching in 2022, the tour has grossed over $735 million and sold 5.8 million tickets. And with 59 shows still to come, it's expected to push past the $1 billion mark, joining the likes of Coldplay and Taylor Swift in the exclusive 10-figure club."
[Music transition]
Host: "The Weeknd is also using his platform for good, partnering with Global Citizen and the United Nations World Food Programme to donate to various funds. And with his newly expanded setlist, featuring songs from his entire career, fans are in for a treat."
[Music transition]
Host: "The tour is already underway, with shows in the UK and Europe kicking off just last night. With multiple nights in cities like Copenhagen, Madrid, and Paris, and five shows at London's Wembley Stadium in August, this is one tour you won't want to miss. That's all for today, folks. Thanks for tuning in."
[Outro music plays]
